verdict.rationale: Conductor gives each task an isolated workspace with terminal/diff/review, lets agents run builds and tests autonomously, and supports checkpoints to revert code/chat state to an earlier turn — all of which support iterating on a bug, testing changes, and reviewing diffs to verify a fix. However, there is no explicit documentation or example describing a reproduce-root cause-verify workflow, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming this specific use case. Missing for 10: explicit debugging/root-cause workflow documentation, first-party or community walkthrough of reproducing and verifying a bug fix, and evidence beyond generic agent/test-running capability.
